overview.description: The Simplify Piper Sandler US Small-Cap PLUS Income ETF (LITL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in small-cap stocks. The fund is actively managed, focusing on US small-cap stocks using a proprietary model and option strategies. The fund aims for capital growth and income LITL was launched on Apr 28, 2025 and is issued by Simplify.
